title: INVITE THE HOLY SPIRIT TO LEAD YOU THIS MORNING
text: Beloved, before we go into the depths of what the spirit of God wants to release over your life this morning, I want you to do something very significant. I want you to share this prayer with someone. Don't just keep it to yourself. There is a principle in the kingdom. When you become a distribution center of grace, you become a candidate for unusual encounters. Share this with your family members, with your friends, with your colleagues. Send it to that prayer group. Send it to your church members. The Bible says in Proverbs that he that [music] waterth shall also be watered himself. As you distribute this seed of grace, you are positioning yourself for uncommon visitations. So right now take a moment and share this. It is not by accident that you are here this morning. Now I want you to understand something very critical. The quality of your day, the quality of your week, the quality of your month, and indeed the quality of your entire life is determined by one fundamental factor, the leadership of the Holy Spirit. You see, many believers are struggling not because they lack potential, not because they lack talents, [music] not even because they lack opportunities, but because they have not learned the mystery of divine guidance. They have not learned what it means [music] to consistently, deliberately, and intentionally invite the Holy Spirit to take charge of their affairs. This morning, we are going to do something that will fundamentally alter the course of your destiny. We are going to invite, we're going to summon, we're going to appeal to the person of the Holy Spirit to take absolute leadership over every dimension of our existence. And I'm telling you, by the authority of the word of God, when the Holy Spirit begins to lead a man, impossibilities become irrelevant. When the Holy Spirit takes charge of your journey, limitations become outdated vocabulary. When the Holy Spirit becomes your guide, you begin to walk in dimensions that other men can only dream about. The scripture is very clear in Romans 8:14. It says, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God." [music] Now, watch this carefully. The Bible did not say as many as are born again are the sons of God. It did not say as many as go to church are the sons of God. It said as many as are led that is present continuous tense as many as are consistently perpetually led by the spirit of God. These are the ones that function as sons. You see sunship is not just about birth. It is about behavior. It is not just about your position in Christ. It is about your submission to the spirit. And so this morning as we gather in this atmosphere of consecration, as we gather with hearts that are hungry, with spirits that are thirsty, with souls that are desperate for divine encounter, we are going to deliberately, consciously, systematically invite the person of the Holy Spirit to take preeminence in our lives. We're going to ask him to lead us in our thoughts, lead us in our decisions, lead us in our relationships, lead us in our businesses, lead us in our ministries, lead us in our academics, lead us in every single thing that concerns us. Now, let me show you something very powerful from the scriptures. In the book of Exodus, when God was leading the children of Israel through the wilderness, the Bible says he went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them the way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light. Now, this is very significant. God did not just appear once in a while. [music] He was continuously present. His guidance was not seasonal. It was perpetual. And that pillar was not just for decoration. It determined their movement, their timing, their direction, their strategy. When the cloud moved, they moved. When the cloud stayed, they stayed. Their entire existence was synchronized with divine leadership. And I'm prophesying to somebody this morning, you are entering a season where you will no longer move by your own wisdom. You will no longer make decisions based on what looks good to the natural eye. You are entering a dimension where every step you take is orchestrated by the spirit of God. You are entering a season of divine synchronization where your timing aligns with heaven's timing, where your decisions align with heaven's agenda, where your movements align with heaven's program. And when a man begins to walk in that dimension, I'm telling you, he becomes unstoppable. He becomes untouchable. He becomes unconquerable. Let me take you to the book of Acts chapter 16. Paul and his team wanted to go to Asia to preach the gospel. The Bible says the Holy Spirit forbade them. They tried to go to Bethnia. Again, the spirit suffered them not. Why? Because God had a different agenda. God had a vision waiting for Paul the Macedonian call. And when Paul obeyed the leadership of the spirit, he ended up in Philippi. And in Philippi, the first European church was established. Can you see what would have happened if Paul had insisted on his own plans? He would have missed the strategic assignment that would change the course of history. So this morning, I am asking the Holy Spirit to deliver you from self-will. I am asking the Holy Spirit to deliver you from the stubbornness that makes you insist on your own way. I am asking the Holy Spirit to give you a heart that is sensitive, a heart that is yielded, a heart that is flexible to divine guidance. Because you see, the Holy Spirit knows things you don't know. He sees dangers you cannot see. He sees opportunities you cannot perceive. He knows the end from the beginning. And when he's leading you, he's not just leading you based on what is convenient. He's leading you based on what is profitable for your destiny. Now, let me introduce you to a very powerful truth this morning. The Holy Spirit is not just a force. He is a person. He's not just an energy. He's a personality. He has intellect. He has emotions. He has will. And because he's a person, he can be grieved. He can be quenched. He can be resisted. But he can also be invited. You can develop a relationship with him. You can fellowship with him. You can communicate with him. And when you learn to recognize his voice, when you learn to discern his prompings, when you learn to follow his gentle leadings, your life becomes a masterpiece of divine orchestration. The Bible says in John 16:3, "How be it, when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth, for he shall not speak of himself, but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak, and he will show you things to come." Do you see the ministry of the Holy Spirit? He's your guide. He's your revealer. He's your informant. He shows you things to come. He gives you insight into the future. He gives you strategic intelligence that positions you for victory before the battle even begins. I remember years ago when I was about to make a very major decision concerning ministry. Everything looked good. The opportunity looked amazing. The people involved were credible, but deep in my spirit, I felt a check. I felt a hesitation. I felt the Holy Spirit saying, "Wait, not yet. Not this." And I obeyed. I stepped back. And within a few months, the whole thing collapsed. What looked like gold was actually glitter. What looked like an opportunity was actually a trap. And if I had not learned to be sensitive to the Holy Spirit, I would have walked right into destruction. So this morning, I'm praying for you. I'm asking God to give you spiritual sensitivity. I'm asking God to open your spiritual ears to hear what the spirit is saying. I'm asking God to deliver you from spiritual dullness, from spiritual deafness, from spiritual blindness. There are people who have eyes but cannot see. There are people who have ears but cannot hear. And the reason is not physical, it is spiritual. Their spiritual senses have not been trained. Their spiritual antenna has not been activated. But I decree over your life this morning, your spiritual senses are being awakened right now in the name of Jesus. Now, let's pray. Don't just read these words. Pray them with intensity. Pray them with faith. Pray them with expectation. Open your mouth and begin to invite the Holy Spirit. Holy Spirit, I welcome you this morning. I invite you into every department of [music] my life. I invite you into my thoughts, into my plans, into my decisions, into my relationships. Holy Spirit, I am not sufficient in myself. I cannot navigate this life with my own wisdom. I need you. I [music] desperately need you. So, I ask you this morning, take absolute leadership. Take the driver's seat. Take control. Lead me in the path of righteousness [music] for your name's sake. Lead me in the way everlasting. Holy Spirit, I submit my will to your will. I surrender my plans to your plans. I yield my agenda to your agenda. Have your way in my life. Holy Spirit, I ask you this morning, give me spiritual sensitivity. Open my spiritual eyes that I may see. Open my spiritual ears that I may hear. Teach me to recognize your voice. Teach me to discern your prompings. Teach me to follow your gentle leadings. Remove from me every form of stubbornness. Remove from me every form of self-will. Remove from me every form of rebellion that would make me resist your guidance. Give me a heart that is quick to obey, a heart that is swift to respond, a heart that is sensitive to your slightest whisper. Holy Spirit, I decree this morning that I will not miss my divine opportunities. I will not walk into traps. I will not fall into ditches. I will not make decisions that I will regret because you are my guide. Because you are my counselor. Because you are my teacher. I will walk in divine wisdom. I will walk in supernatural intelligence. I [music] will walk in strategic advantage. Lead me, Holy Spirit. Lead me in my business. Lead me in my career. Lead me in my ministry. Lead me in my relationships. Lead me in my finances. Lead me in my health. Lead me in every single area of my life. Now beloved, I want to take you deeper into this mystery of divine guidance. You see, there are levels to the leadership of the Holy Spirit. There are dimensions to his [music] guidance. Some people experience the Holy Spirit's leadership occasionally. Some people experience it seasonally, but there is a realm where you experience it perpetually. There is a dimension where you live in constant communion with the spirit, where you walk in continuous fellowship, where you abide in unbroken consciousness of his presence. The apostle Paul writing to the Galatians in chapter 5:1 16 says, "Walk in the spirit and ye shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh." Now the word walk is very significant. Walking is not a one-time event. Walking is a continuous action. It is step by step. It is moment by moment. It is day by day. Paul is saying live your entire life in the atmosphere of the spirit. Conduct your affairs under the supervision of the spirit. Make your decisions in consultation with the spirit. And when you do this, the Bible says, "You shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh." You see, many believers are fighting battles they don't need to fight. They are struggling with temptations they don't need to struggle with. They are falling into sins they don't need to fall into. And the reason is simple. They are not walking in the spirit. They are walking in their own strength. They are walking in their own wisdom. [music] They are walking in their own ability. And so they are vulnerable to every attack of the enemy. They are susceptible to every deception of the devil. They are prone to every trap that is set against them. But when you learn to walk in the spirit, when you learn to maintain that constant communion when you learn to live in perpetual fellowship, something supernatural begins to happen. You begin to receive prompings. You begin to receive warnings. You begin to receive insights. The spirit will tell you, "Don't go there." The spirit will tell you, "Don't do that." The spirit will tell you, "Don't say that." The spirit will tell you don't enter into that transaction. The spirit will tell you don't form that relationship. And if you are sensitive enough to obey, you will avoid disasters that would have destroyed your life. I want to share a testimony with you. There was a time when I was about to board a flight. Everything was already checked in. My bags were already on the plane. But as I was about to enter the aircraft, I felt this strong check in my spirit. It was like a restraint. It was like an invisible hand holding me back. And the spirit whispered to me, "Don't board this flight." Now, in the natural, it didn't make sense. I had important meetings to attend. I had people waiting for me. But I have learned over the years to obey the spirit even when I don't understand. So, I stepped aside. I canled my trip. And you know what happened? That flight had a major mechanical [music] problem midair. It was a terrifying experience for everyone on board. Some people were injured. And when I heard the news, I fell on my knees and worshiped God because the Holy Spirit loved me enough to warn me. He cared about me enough to protect me. He valued me enough to guide me. And this morning, I am prophesying to you, the Holy Spirit is going to begin to warn you about dangers ahead. He is going to begin to alert you about traps that have been set for you. He is going to begin to show you pitfalls before you fall into them. But you must develop the sensitivity to hear him. You must develop the discipline to obey him. You must develop the humility to trust him even when his guidance doesn't make sense to your natural mind. Let me show you something very profound from the life of Jesus. In the Gospel of John 5:1 19, Jesus said, "Verily, verily, I say unto you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do, for what thingsoever he doeth, this also doeth the Son likewise." Jesus, the son of God, operated by divine guidance. He did nothing on his own initiative. He only did what he saw the father doing. He only spoke what he heard the father speaking. His entire ministry was a demonstration of divine synchronization. And if Jesus who is God in flesh operated by this principle, how much more do we need to operate by this principle? If Jesus who had all power, all wisdom, all knowledge, still chose to be led by the father, how much more do we who are limited, who are finite, who are fable need to be led by the holy spirit. This is not optional, beloved. This is not a luxury. This is a necessity. This is a requirement for supernatural living. Now, I want to talk to you about what happens when the Holy Spirit leads you. Number one, you experience supernatural timing. There is something called the [music] chyros moment, the appointed time, the strategic season, the divine opportunity. When the Holy Spirit is leading you, he positions you at the right place at the right time. He connects you with the right people at the right season. He opens doors for you that no man can shut. He closes doors that no man can open. Your life becomes a testimony of divine orchestration. Look at the life of Joseph. From the pit to the prison to the palace, every step, even the painful ones, was part of a [music] divine setup. The Holy Spirit was positioning him, preparing him, promoting him. And at the appointed time, at the kyus moment, he was promoted from the prison to the palace in one day. Not by might, NOT BY POWER, but by the spirit of the Lord. That is what happens when the Holy Spirit is leading you. Your promotion doesn't depend on who you know. Your elevation doesn't depend on your credentials. Your breakthrough doesn't depend on your connections because the Holy Spirit knows how to supernaturally position you for divine opportunities. Number two, when the Holy Spirit leads you, you experience supernatural provision. The Bible says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." When the Holy Spirit is your guide, he doesn't just lead you to opportunities, he leads you to provision, he leads you to resources, he leads you to supply. I remember a season in ministry when we needed finances for a major project. We had exhausted all our known sources. We had done all we knew to do in the natural. But I felt the Holy Spirit say to me, "Go to this particular city." Now, in the natural, it didn't make sense. We had no connections in that city. We had no contacts. We had no relationships. But I obeyed. And when I got there, God connected me with someone who didn't even know me, who had never heard of our ministry, but who felt led by the spirit to support the project. And the amount that came was more than enough to complete what we needed to do. You see, when the Holy Spirit leads you, he leads you to your provision. He leads you to your supply. He leads you to your helpers. He leads you to your financiers. He leads you to your sponsors. You don't have to beg. You don't have to manipulate. You don't have to struggle. You just have to obey. And when you get to where he's leading you, you will find what he has already prepared for you. Number three, when the Holy Spirit leads you, you experience supernatural protection. Psalm 91:1 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." When the Holy Spirit is leading you, you are walking in divine protection. You are covered by angelic guard. You are shielded by supernatural security. There are accidents you will not have. There are sicknesses you will not suffer. There are tragedies you will not experience. Not because you are lucky, but because you are led. Not because you are special, but because you are [music] submitted. Not because you are powerful, but because you are positioned under divine leadership. I decree over your life this morning, no weapon formed against you shall prosper, every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. No evil [music] shall befall you. Neither shall any plague come near your dwelling because you have made the Lord your refuge. Because you have made the most high your habitation because you have invited the Holy Spirit to lead you. You are walking in supernatural protection. Now let me pray with you again. Open your mouth and pray these words with intensity. Holy Spirit, I thank you for your leadership in my life. I thank you for your guidance. I thank you for your protection. I thank you for your provision. Holy Spirit, I'm asking you this morning, lead me into my divine opportunities. Lead me to my helpers. Lead me to my financiers. Lead me to my sponsors. Lead me to the people who will celebrate me, who will support me, who will partner with me in destiny. Holy Spirit, lead me away from every trap. Lead me away from every snare. Lead me away from every danger. Protect me from accidents. Protect me from sicknesses. Protect me from tragedies. Protect me from every evil plan of the enemy. Holy Spirit, I receive supernatural timing. I receive kyus moments. I receive divine appointments. I decree that I'll be at the right place at the right time. I will meet the right people at the right season. Doors that have been closed against me are opening now by the power of the Holy Spirit. Opportunities that have been denied me are being released now by divine intervention. Holy Spirit, lead me into my season of uncommon favor. Lead me into my season of supernatural promotion. Lead me into my season of divine elevation. I will not struggle. I will not strive. I will not manipulate. I will simply follow your leading and walk into my prepared blessings. Beloved, I want to show you something very critical about the [music] Holy Spirit's leadership. The Holy Spirit doesn't just lead you externally in your circumstances. He also leads you internally in your character development. You see, one of the major assignments of the Holy Spirit is to transform you into the image of Christ. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 3:17, "Now the Lord is that spirit." And where the spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. And then verse 18 says, "But we all with open face, beholding as in a glass, the glory of the Lord are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the spirit of the Lord." The Holy Spirit is not just interested in fixing your external problems. He's interested in transforming your internal [music] personality. is interested in dealing with your character flaws, your emotional wounds, your behavioral patterns, your thought processes. Because you see, your external success is limited by your internal development. Your public promotion is limited by your private preparation. Your outward blessing is limited by your inward transformation. And so when you invite the Holy Spirit to lead you, one of the things he will begin to do is to convict you of areas in your life that need to change. He will begin to show you attitudes that need to be adjusted. He will begin to reveal to you mindsets that need to be renewed. He will begin to expose to you habits that need to be broken. And this is not condemnation. This is conviction. This is not criticism. This is correction. This is the loving work of a father who is preparing you for greater glory. So don't resist the Holy Spirit when he begins to deal with you. Don't fight him when he begins to correct you. Don't run away when he begins to convict you. Submit to the process. Yield to the transformation. Cooperate with the change because on the other side of that transformation is a version of you that is stronger, wiser, more mature, more effective, more anointed, more impactful. I remember when the Holy Spirit began to deal with me concerning my temperament. I had a quick temper. I would react quickly to offenses. I would respond sharply to criticisms. And for a long time, I justified it. I called it righteous anger. I called it standing up for truth. But the Holy Spirit began to show me that it was actually pride. It was actually insecurity. It was actually fear. And he began to work on me to transform me, to teach me patience, to [music] teach me humility, to teach me how to respond instead of reacting. And that transformation didn't happen overnight. It was a process. It was a journey. There were times when I failed. There were times when I fell back into old patterns. But the Holy Spirit was patient with me. He didn't give up on me. He kept working on me, correcting me, teaching me, shaping me. And today, I can testify that I'm not the same person I used to be. The Holy Spirit has done a work in me that has positioned me for greater assignment, for deeper intimacy with God, for more effective ministry. And this morning, I'm praying for you. I'm asking the Holy Spirit to begin a work of transformation in your life. I'm asking him to deal with those areas that have been limiting you, that have been hindering you, [music] that have been holding you back. I'm asking him to break those patterns, to heal those wounds, to renew those mindsets. And I decree that as you submit to his work, as you yield to [music] his process, you will emerge as a new creation, transformed from glory to [music] glory. Now, let me pray with you one more time. This time, I want you to pray with total honesty. Pray with vulnerability. Pray with transparency. Holy Spirit, I invite you to search my heart. I invite you to examine my motives. I invite you to expose those areas in my life that need to change. Holy Spirit, I don't want to remain the same. I don't want to stay in my old patterns. I don't want to continue in my old ways. I want to be transformed. I want to be changed. I want to be renewed. So I ask you this morning, convict me of sin. Convict me of pride. Convict me of fear. Convict me of bitterness. Convict me of unforgiveness. Convict me of rebellion. Convict me of every attitude, every mindset, every habit that is not pleasing to you. Holy Spirit, I am asking you to break those patterns in my life that have been limiting my progress. Break those cycles that have been repeating themselves generation after generation. Break those strongholds that have been controlling my behavior. I submit myself to your transforming power. I yield myself to your refining fire. Do a deep work in me, Holy Spirit. Don't let me remain the same. Change me from glory to glory. Transform into the image of Christ. Make me more like Jesus in my character, in my attitude, in my behavior, in my responses, in my relationships, in everything that I do. Beloved, as we begin to come to the climax of this ministration, I want to give you some practical steps for maintaining the leadership of the Holy Spirit in your life. Number one, cultivate a lifestyle of prayer. Prayer is not just talking to God. Prayer is communing with God. It is fellowshipping with him. It is spending time in his presence. When you pray, you create an atmosphere where the Holy Spirit [music] can speak to you, guide you, instruct you, correct you. Make prayer your lifestyle, not just your emergency response. Don't just pray when you have problems. Pray when everything is going well. Don't just pray when you need something. Pray because you love him. Don't just pray long prayers once in a while. Pray short prayers consistently throughout the day. Develop that constant communion, that perpetual fellowship, that unbroken consciousness of his presence. Number two, study the word of God. The Bible says in 2 Timothy 3:16, "All scripture is given by inspiration of God and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness." The word of God is the primary way the Holy Spirit speaks to you. When you read the word, the Holy Spirit illuminates it to you. He gives you understanding. He gives you revelation. He gives you insight. He applies the word to your specific situation, your specific challenge, your specific season. So, make the word of God your daily bread. Don't just read it casually. Study it intentionally. Meditate on it consistently. Memorize it deliberately. Let the word dwell in you richly. And as you do this, you will find that the Holy Spirit will use the word to guide you, to direct you, to instruct you in the way you should go. Number three, develop spiritual sensitivity through fasting. Fasting is a powerful tool for sharpening your spiritual senses. When you fast, you crucify the flesh. You silence the noise of your carnal appetites. You create a quiet space where you can hear the gentle voice of the Holy Spirit more clearly. Jesus said in Matthew 17 concerning certain levels of demonic activity, this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting. So don't neglect the discipline of fasting. Don't see it as legalism. Don't see it as religious obligation. See it as a strategic weapon for spiritual sensitivity. Fast regularly. Fast intentionally. fast with purpose and watch how your spiritual antenna becomes more sensitive to the prompings of the Holy Spirit. Number four, obey the prompings of the Holy Spirit immediately. One of the ways you train yourself in spiritual sensitivity [music] is by obeying quickly. When the Holy Spirit tells you to do something, don't delay. Don't hesitate. Don't analyze it to death. Just obey. When he tells you to give, give immediately. When he tells you to call someone, call them immediately. When he tells you to pray for someone, pray for them immediately. When he tells you to go somewhere, go immediately. This principle of immediate obedience trains your spirit to be sensitive to his voice. It builds your capacity to trust him even when you don't understand. It positions you for greater revelations, greater instructions, greater assignments [music] because the Holy Spirit gives more responsibility to those who are faithful with small instructions. Number five, fellowship with spiritfilled believers. The Bible says in Proverbs 27:17, "Rion sharpeneth iron, so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend." The people you surround yourself with will either sharpen your spiritual sensitivity or dull it. If you fellowship with people who are spiritually minded, who are hungry for God, who are sensitive to the spirit, you will find yourself becoming [music] more sensitive. But if you fellowship with people who are carnal, who are worldly, who are spiritually dead, you will find yourself becoming dull. So be intentional about your relationships. Be strategic about your friendships. Be selective about your associations. Connect with people who will provoke you to spiritual growth, who will challenge you to deeper consecration, who will inspire you to greater intimacy with God. Now, let me pray a final prayer of activation over your life. This is not just a prayer of request. This is a prayer of declaration. This is a prayer of activation. This is a prayer that releases what has already been provided in Christ. So, pray these words with authority. Pray them with boldness. Pray them with faith. Holy Spirit, I activate your leadership in my life right now. I decree that from this moment forward, I am a spirit-led believer. I am not governed by circumstances. I am not controlled by emotions. I am not driven by pressures. I am led by the spirit of the living God. Holy Spirit, I receive supernatural sensitivity. I receive spiritual discernment. I receive divine insight. My spiritual eyes are opened. My spiritual ears are unstopped. My spiritual senses are activated. I can hear your voice clearly. I can discern your prompings accurately. I can follow your leadings confidently. Holy Spirit, I decree that I will not miss my divine opportunities. I will not walk past my prepared blessings. I will not overlook my assigned helpers. I will not ignore my strategic connections because you are leading me. I will be at the right place at the right time. I will meet the right people at the right season. I will say the right words at the right moment. I will make the right decisions at critical junctions. My life is synchronized with heaven's agenda. My timing is aligned with divine orchestration. My movements are coordinated with supernatural strategy. Holy Spirit, I receive supernatural protection. No weapon formed against me [music] shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. No evil shall befall me. No plague shall come near my dwelling. No accident shall terminate my destiny. No sickness shall cut short my assignment. No tragedy shall abort my purpose. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am guarded by angels. I am protected by divine power. I walk in supernatural safety all the days of my life. Holy Spirit, I receive transformation. I receive character development. I receive internal change. Work on me. Holy Spirit, transform me from glory to glory. Remove from me every attitude that is not like Christ. Remove from me every mindset that is contrary to the kingdom. Remove from me every habit that is limiting my progress. Make me more like Jesus. Make me more effective for the kingdom. Make me more impactful for destiny. I am being transformed by the renewing of my mind. I am being changed from glory to glory. I am becoming the person God has called me to be. Holy Spirit, I thank you for this morning. I thank you for this encounter. I thank you for this activation. I receive everything you have released over my life. I walk in it. I live in it. I operate in it from this day forward. My life is a testimony of divine guidance. My story is a demonstration of supernatural leadership. My journey is a manifestation of spirit-led living. I am not ordinary. I am not average. I am not common. I am a son of God led by the spirit of God walking in the fullness of my divine destiny. In Jesus mighty name I pray. Amen. And amen. Now beloved, as you go from this place, I want you to maintain a conscious awareness of the Holy Spirit's presence. Talk to him throughout your day. Acknowledge him in all your ways. Consult him before making decisions. Listen for his prompings. Watch for his leading. And I promise you, your life will never be the same again. You are [music] entering a season of supernatural guidance. You are entering a dimension of divine orchestration. You are entering a realm of spirit-led living. And in this realm, all things are possible. In this realm, impossibilities become irrelevant. In this realm, limitations become outdated vocabulary. Walk in it, live in it, operate in it, and may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you now and forever more. Amen.
